title: Unit prices with XLOOKUP
objective: Look up a value from a product table with an exact-match XLOOKUP, fixed table references and a not-found fallback.
instructions: In C2:C5, look up each order line's unit price (KES) from the price list in E1:G6 with XLOOKUP. Fix the price list with $ signs so the formula can be reused on every row. If a code is not on the price list, show the text "Not listed" instead of #N/A.
hints: XLOOKUP has three parts plus an optional fourth: =XLOOKUP(what to find, where to look, what to return, [if not found]).
Look for the code in B2 inside the Code column of the price list, and return the matching cell from the Price column.
Add $ signs to the price list ranges (for example $E$2:$E$6) so they stay fixed on every row, while B2 becomes B3, B4 and B5.
Text matching ignores upper and lower case, so "sd-120" finds "SD-120". The fourth argument, in double quotes, replaces #N/A.
